name: Sacred Heart and Our Lady, Oldham

boundary.description: From the junction of Ripponden Road and Ship Lane, along Saddleworth Civil Parish boundary to the S border of Lower Strinesdale Reservoir. Then W by a bee-line to Furze Lane, excluding all of Armdale Rise estate. SW along Furze Lane, NW border of Waterhead Park and then S by Sharples Hall Street and by a beeline to and along Leamington Street, Vincent Avenue, Little Moor Lane, Shrewsbury Avenue, Vulcan Street, Prince Charlie Street, Derker Street, Arnold Street to the Railway. Then N along the railway to the point opposite Sumner Streer, and E to the Saddleworth Civil Parish boundary and Lower Dingle. E along Lower Dingle to Ripponden Road and its junction with Ship Lane.
